name: University of Cincinnati
header:

United States · Mathematical Sciences PhD
Roster and rank verification handled separately
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to

• Current central English waiver requires an action after submission.
• Funding guarantee wording differs between department FAQ and webpage.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
Bachelor's in mathematics or related field expected. Prerequisites: multivariable calculus, ODE, linear algebra,
proof experience. [s1]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Create graduate application; arrange three referees, unofficial transcript, SOP and English waiver
documentation. Prior supervisor commitment not listed. [s1] [s3]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Department emphasizes analysis/PDE/probability; assess fit carefully for algebraic geometry/representation
theory. [s1]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Department supplies step-by-step application video. Upload requested documents only; extra unsolicited
materials are not added. [s1] [s4]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Mathematics page explicitly opens Fall 2027; central policies are standing. [s1]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
February 1, 2027 full consideration, then while positions remain; visa-requiring international materials before
April 1. Time/cutoff zone unspecified. [s1]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
February 1 full-consideration target; automatic assistantship assessment. [s1]
Reference receipt; Test-score receipt; Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Complete file by program deadline; no separate reference/score grace period. Final official degree transcript by
first class day. [s3] [s4]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal reply date established in reviewed admissions pages; offer controls. [s4]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Department admission/assistantship thresholds: TOEFL 80/93, IELTS 6.5/7, PTE 54/64, DET 110/115. Central
2026-scale TOEFL minimum 4.5; higher math TA equivalent needs clarification. [s1] [s3]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
UChicago degree route qualifies in principle, including expected degree. After submission email
grad.admissions@uc.edu with documentation that the institution teaches entirely in English; waiver cannot be
applied before submission. [s3]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not required; quantitative 160+ recommended. Department permits uploaded unofficial score sheet. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
Subject-test requirement/recommendation not independently specified; generic GRE wording principally refers
to General quantitative score. [s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Unresolved]
FAQ promises tuition scholarship, stipend and health-insurance award, but no annual cash amount published in
reviewed sources. [s2]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Most students supported throughout degree; no fixed guaranteed number of years established. [s2]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International assistantship English thresholds explicitly published; eligible for consideration. [s1]
Conditions and duties [Unresolved]
Assistantship funding; exact workload, fees excluded and summer guarantee need offer clarification. [s2]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Automatic standard assistantship review; no separate form, essay or reference specified. [s1]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Faculty/program funding and international-student external scholarships; conference travel support available.
[s1] [s4]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 70 international standard graduate degree fee, paid after submission; mathematics is not CEAS (whose
fee is USD 80). [s3] [s4]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Published automatic waivers are for US military active duty/veterans. General international hardship waiver not
identified. [s4]

sections.title: Conflicts and remaining checks
sections.text:
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
FAQ says all admitted PhDs receive funding unless otherwise funded; webpage says most PhDs receive full
support. Obtain written funding terms. Department permits GRE screenshot while general policy requires
official scores when tests are required. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm annual stipend, guarantee/summer/fees, GRE Math treatment, pending-bachelor English-waiver
documentation, precise referee timing and offer reply date. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s4]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Number theory
Seungki Kim
Lattice problems, geometry of numbers, homogeneous dynamics and cryptography. [s5] [s6]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2024, JLMS 109: e12830 · Adelic Rogers integral formula
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Tara L. Smith
Quadratic forms, division algebras, Galois groups, valuations and ordered fields; no recent paper list verified.
[s7] [q8]
Official profile identifies Professor Emerita and NSF program director; ordinary new PhD supervision must not be assumed.
Research evidence: 2010 · Galois realizability of groups of order 64
Historical relevant paper on the university profile, which explicitly labels Smith Professor Emerita. Recent research and new
doctoral supervision are not established.
